title: npm client configured with a cleartext registry
description: .npmrc declares an npm registry URL that uses cleartext http. Every package and every publish travels unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different tarball than the one the lockfile recorded.
remediation: Point the client at an https registry with a valid certificate.
limitation: It matches an npm registry URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
